images.caption: An Avro Lancaster of No. 1 Group, Bomber Command, silhouetted against flares, smoke and explosions during the attack on Hamburg, Germany, by aircraft of Nos. 1, 5 and 8 Groups on the night of 30/31 January 1943. This raid was the first occasion on which H2S centimetric radar was used by the Pathfinder aircraft to navigate the force to the target. The pilot of the photographing aircraft (Lancaster 'ZN-Y' of No. 106 Squadron, based at Syerston) was Flt Lt D J Shannon who, as a member of No. 617 Squadron, took part in Operation CHASTISE (the "Dams Raid") during the following May.
images.alt: An Avro Lancaster of No. 1 Group, Bomber Command, silhouetted against flares, smoke and explosions during the attack on Hamburg, Germany, by aircraft of Nos. 1, 5 and 8 Groups on the night of 30/31 January 1943. This raid was the first occasion on which H2S centimetric radar was used by the Pathfinder aircraft to navigate the force to the target. The pilot of the photographing aircraft (Lancaster 'ZN-Y' of No. 106 Squadron, based at Syerston) was Flt Lt D J Shannon who, as a member of No. 617 Squadron, took part in Operation CHASTISE (the "Dams Raid") during the following May.

images.filename: Bundesarchiv Bild 183-2005-0706-506, Hamburg, Wasserspürer im Einsatz.jpg
images.caption:
For documentary purposes the German Federal Archive often retained the original image captions, which may be erroneous, biased, obsolete or politically extreme. Hamburg, Wasserspürer im Einsatz
Ein neuer Beruf, der eine Folge des Bombenkrieges sein dürfte, ist der Beruf des Wasserspürers. Im Geschäftsjahr 1948 hatten die Hamburger Wasserwerke einen Schwund von 28,8 Millionen cbm Wasser, d. s. 26% der Jahresmenge, der durch schadhafte Rohre besonders in den Trümmergegenden hervorgerufen wird. Zwei-Mann-Trupps sind jetzt eingesetzt, um die "Übeltäter" mit Hilfe eines aus einer empfindlichen Membrane bestehenden Gerätes festzustellen.
8-7-49                  
Illus-dpd
